Thanks for taking the time today  great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Key goals you shared: reduce inference cost for embedding workflows, tighten 95th percentile latency for customer-facing features, and establish an audit trail for data access.
- Potential fit: Redwood Dedicated or Private depending on your security needs; we think a technical deep dive with our SE makes sense to validate throughput numbers and integration.

Proposed next step: a 60-minute technical deep dive with Sean + engineering on our side to review your telemetry and go over integration options. Can you do any of the following (all PT)?

- Thu Feb 12: 9:009:0010:00 AM or 3:004:00 PM
- Fri Feb 13: 11:0011:0012:00 PM or 2:003:00 PM

I’ve attached a 1page discovery summary (see attachment). If those times don’t work, send a few windows that do and I’ll confirm quickly  we’ll tighten confirmation on day-of (calendar invite + reminder).

Thanks  looking forward to continuing.


